name: Arakawa Tenkai
source:
A priest with a gentle and supportive nature nestled beneath a sometimes rough exterior. He's seen as a father figure to the children he looks after at the church. He has a passion for martial arts above all else and likes a simple life, preferring to teach through the world around him rather than purely through scripture.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4838460/HimaNatsu_Of_Churches_Sunflowers_and_Long_Summers/]Steam[/url]]
